name: BlueBillywigNativePlayerKit-iOS
summary: iOS SDK for playing Blue Billywig video content with native playback
description:
The Blue Billywig Native Player Kit is an iOS SDK for playing video content from
the Blue Billywig Online Video Platform. It provides native AVFoundation-based
playback with support for IMA advertising, Chromecast, Picture-in-Picture, AirPlay,
vertical video (Shorts), and a full playback control API with event-driven delegates.

script_phases.name: Blue Billywig distribution notice
script_phases.script: echo "warning: BlueBillywigNativePlayerKit-iOS: CocoaPods Trunk stops accepting new versions on 2 Dec 2026. 8.64 is the last version on CocoaPods. Newer versions ship via Swift Package Manager only. See https://support.bluebillywig.com/native-sdk/ios-sdk-cocoapods-to-swift-package-manager/"
